description: In every PA-model, a predicate defined by an arithmetic formula with finitely many parameters satisfies induction.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.definable_induction.{u} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA] (P : M → Prop)
  (hP : Set.univ.Definable₁ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language {x | P x})
  (hz : P (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M))
  (hs : ∀ (x : M), P x → P (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M x)) (x : M) : P x
